title: Reminders & follow-ups
summary: "Remind me to call Priya on Friday at 5" — Ava brings it back on time, in the app and on Telegram, and can move or cancel it when plans change.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder or follow-up for the owner. Ava will bring it back at that time. The result includes the reminder's id.

task.description: What to remind them about, as a short clean phrase in plain words: fix typos and drop filler ('remind me that I need to deinnk water' becomes 'Drink water'). E.g. 'Call Priya'

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List the owner's open reminders and follow-ups, soonest first, with each one's id, task and time. It only reads reminders this skill made.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Move an open reminder to a new time and/or change its task. Give the id and at least one of when or task.

id.description: The reminder's id, from create_reminder or list_reminders. Never guess it.

when.description: The new time, in words: 'tomorrow at 7pm', 'in 30 minutes'

task.description: The new task in a few words

tools.name: cancel_reminder
tools.description: Cancel an open reminder so it is not delivered.

id.description: The reminder's id, from create_reminder or list_reminders. Never guess it.
